items.title: PepsiCo recalls Doritos Chilli Heatwave because of undeclared milk
items.description: PepsiCo is recalling Doritos Chilli Heatwave because some packs contain milk which is not mentioned on the label. Some packs may have been packed with the wrong product which contains milk.
items.SMStext: PepsiCo recalls Doritos Chilli Heatwave because of undeclared milk https://bit.ly/4wMVwzB
items.twitterText: PepsiCo recalls Doritos Chilli Heatwave because of undeclared milk #FoodAllergy https://alerts.food.gov.uk/news-alerts/alert/fsa-aa-38-2026
items.actionTaken: PepsiCo is recalling the above product from customers and has been advised to contact the relevant allergy support organisations, which will tell their members about the recall. The company has also issued a point-of-sale notice to its customers. These notices explain to customers why the product is being recalled and tell them what to do if they have bought the product. Please see the attached notice.
items.consumerAdvice: If you have bought the above product and have an allergy or intolerance to milk or milk constituents, do not eat it. Instead return it to the store from where it was bought for a full refund. For more information, or to receive a full refund, please contact PepsiCo Consumer Care Line on 0800 274777 or visit contact.pepsico.com/walkers.

Allergen: Milk
This product contains milk making it a possible health risk for anyone with an allergy or intolerance to milk or milk constituents.

allergen.riskStatement: This product contains Milk making it a possible health risk for anyone with an allergy or intolerance to milk or milk constituents
allergen.description: Milk is a common ingredient in butter, cheese, cream, milk powders and yoghurt. It can also be found in foods brushed or glazed with milk, and in powdered soups and sauces
